title: Increment labels up to a scaling factor
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, a scaling identifier $c$, and a natural number $i$, let $q_c$ be its scaling factor. If $i<q_c$, assign the label that increments counter $c$ at position $i$; otherwise assign the label for counter $c$ itself.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
